plugins.name: private-credit
plugins.description: Domain-specific skills and commands for private credit analysts and portfolio managers at direct lending funds. Covers covenant compliance, EBITDA adjustments, IC memo generation, quarterly monitoring, deal screening, credit modeling, amendment analysis, and scenario testing.

skills.name: borrower-monitoring
headings: Quarterly Monitoring Workflow — Step by Step
Step 1: Receive and Review the Package
Step 2: Extract and Update the Quarterly Model
How Many Quarters to Call a Trend
What Gets a Borrower Off the Watchlist
skills.description_zh: 开展私募信贷借款人的季度持续监控，审核财务包与合规材料、更新 Excel 信贷模型，并整理信用趋势、关注名单和管理层沟通事项。

skills.name: covenant-compliance
headings: Reconciliation: Why the Numbers Often Don't Tie
skills.description_zh: 审核借款人财务契约、合规证明和安全余量；以签字合规证明中的 LTM Compliance EBITDA 为依据，单独核对季度累计值，对无法解释的差异提出问题。

skills.name: credit-memo-standards
headings: IC Memo Section Order — New Deal
skills.description_zh: 起草、审核或组织私募信贷的新交易、修订及投资组合投委会备忘录；采用 PowerPoint，优先说明业务、融资条款、投资理由与主要风险。

skills.name: credit-model-standards
headings: Free Cash Flow Waterfall — Exact Build
skills.description_zh: 建立、审核或修改私募信贷承销、季度更新和情景分析模型，按信贷用途调整 LBO 模型结构，组织假设、三张报表及相关计算。

skills.name: ebitda-addback-treatment
headings: Step 3: Track on an LTM Basis
Sanity Check: Cash Flow Statement Cross-Reference
When to Highlight and Potentially Exclude
skills.description_zh: 审核 EBITDA 加回与信贷协议调整，从净利润、所得税、折旧摊销和利息构建 EBITDA 瀑布；先解释报表差异，再核对加回和合规证明。

skills.name: quarterly-package-extraction
headings: Handling Discrepancies Between Financials and Compliance Certificate
Rule: The Compliance Certificate Is the Source of Truth
EBITDA May Not Be Fully Bridgeable
skills.description_zh: 从借款人季度财务报表和合规材料中提取数据，按利润表、资产负债表、现金流量表顺序更新信贷模型；保留来源，明确缺失项目与口径差异。

commands.name: amendment-summary
commands.description: Structured summary of every change in a credit amendment

commands.name: cim-screen
commands.description: Screen a CIM or teaser for credit fit: Pass / Pursue / More Info
headings: Step 1: Quick Read (Simulate the First 5-10 Minutes)

commands.name: covenant-check
commands.description: Full covenant compliance snapshot with headroom analysis

commands.name: ic-memo
commands.description: Generate a full IC memo from deal inputs (CIM + model + term sheet)
headings: Section 1: Executive Summary / Deal Setup (1-2 slides equivalent)
Section 2: Sources & Uses + Capital Structure (1 slide equivalent)
Section 3: Term Sheet Summary (1-2 slides equivalent)

commands.name: quarterly-review
commands.description: Produce covenant table, variance summary, and management questions from quarterly package

commands.name: scenario-analysis
commands.description: Base / Downside / Stress case comparison with covenant breach flagging
